cases.title: The Blackwood Stairwell
cases.summary: Recurring footsteps and an apparent additional landing were reported inside a condemned residential stairwell.
cases.publicFinding: Structural resonance explained the footsteps. A forty-seven-second recording made after the building was vacated remains unclassified.

timeline.label: Report accepted
timeline.detail: Six residents described footsteps stopping one floor above the roof access.

timeline.label: Follow-up complete
timeline.detail: Site remains physically consistent. Audio item BLK-A17 retained for review.

evidence.title: Roof-access roomtone
evidence.summary: Forty-seven seconds; eight apparent footfall patterns.

evidence.title: Structural resonance survey
evidence.summary: Primary reported sounds recreated under controlled conditions.

cases.title: Kestrel Hotel
cases.summary: Guests report waking in rooms that do not appear on the registered floor plan.
cases.publicFinding: The fifth-floor corridor gains between one and three doors during power interruptions. No unauthorized construction has been identified.

timeline.label: Cluster detected
timeline.detail: Four unrelated guests submitted matching reports within nine hours.

timeline.label: Containment extended
timeline.detail: The fifth floor remains closed. Remote monitoring continues.

evidence.title: Hallway camera compilation
evidence.summary: Three synchronized feeds disagree on the number of doors.

evidence.title: Key card 514
evidence.summary: Issued by no known encoder; opens linen storage when tested.

cases.title: The Morrow Line
cases.summary: A disconnected railway telephone rings shortly before local missing-person reports.
cases.publicFinding: The line is physically severed in two locations. Calls contain station ambience and a calm request not to board.

timeline.label: Report accepted
timeline.detail: A preservation volunteer answered the decommissioned platform telephone.

timeline.label: Receiver replaced
timeline.detail: Replacement hardware rang before connection to the wall line.

evidence.title: Incoming call 08
evidence.summary: Voice advises an unknown passenger to remain on the platform.

evidence.title: Replacement receiver
evidence.summary: No independent power source located.

cases.title: Apartment 6B
cases.summary: A tenant receives maintenance notices from the former occupant of an apartment absent from the building registry.
cases.publicFinding: Notices accurately describe faults before they occur. The named sender died eleven years before the building opened.

timeline.label: Report accepted
timeline.detail: Tenant uploaded four handwritten maintenance slips.

timeline.label: New notice received
timeline.detail: The notice thanks DSN for fixing the lift tomorrow.

evidence.title: Maintenance notices
evidence.summary: Paper and ink are ordinary; the handwriting match is unresolved.

evidence.title: Municipal query capture
evidence.summary: Screen recording shows a unit not retained in server logs.

cases.title: Bellweather Reservoir
cases.summary: Emergency weather bulletins named streets beneath a reservoir completed in 1971.
cases.publicFinding: A hobby transmitter explained the carrier signal. Neither the speaker nor the named streets could be identified.

timeline.label: Broadcast captured
timeline.detail: Three vehicle radios received an evacuation notice during clear weather.

timeline.label: Case resolved
timeline.detail: No further broadcasts occurred after equipment removal.

evidence.title: Evacuation bulletin
evidence.summary: Names five streets absent from pre-reservoir survey maps.

evidence.title: Hobby transmitter
evidence.summary: Capable of producing the reported carrier signal.

cases.title: Saint Orison Ward
cases.summary: Night staff repeatedly counted an occupied hospital ward between two sealed service corridors.
cases.publicFinding: Fatigue and a mirrored wayfinding panel accounted for most reports. Bed 18 remained occupied in every thermal scan.

timeline.label: Staff reports merged
timeline.detail: Eleven reports described the same unregistered ward.

timeline.label: Archive decision
timeline.detail: Site access withdrawn by hospital administration.

evidence.title: Bed 18 thermal sequence
evidence.summary: Human-temperature form persists after room clearance.

evidence.title: Service corridor plans
evidence.summary: No legal or historic record of the reported ward.

cases.title: The Dry River Procession
cases.summary: Parallel footprints cross a dry riverbed after storms without approaching or leaving the watercourse.
cases.publicFinding: The tracks represent at least thirty-seven people walking in single file. No matching entry or exit tracks have been recorded.

timeline.label: Community report
timeline.detail: Local survey photographs were submitted for authentication.

timeline.label: Recurrence documented
timeline.detail: Tracks returned ninety minutes before measurable rainfall.

evidence.title: Footprint cast 11
evidence.summary: Preserves an obsolete commercial tread pattern.

evidence.title: Riverbed survey
evidence.summary: No lateral approach tracks visible for 3.2 kilometres.

cases.title: Orchard House Calls
cases.summary: Unplugged telephones in an abandoned farmhouse rang nightly and requested repairs by name.
cases.publicFinding: Two students admitted staging the calls. One authenticated recording predates their equipment purchase by four months.

timeline.label: Report trends
timeline.detail: Clips from the farmhouse reached the community front page.

timeline.label: Residual retained
timeline.detail: An earlier call could not be reproduced or attributed.

evidence.title: Hidden transmitters
evidence.summary: Account for fourteen of fifteen published clips.

evidence.title: Original voicemail
evidence.summary: Metadata verified by two independent reviewers.

cases.title: The Salt Room
cases.summary: A sealed room returns after removal while producing salt at a rate inconsistent with local conditions.
cases.publicFinding: Demolition and wall replacement have occurred twice. Each replacement develops an inward-opening door within thirteen days.

timeline.label: Site secured
timeline.detail: Owner reported a room absent from property deeds and family memory.

timeline.label: Third door forming
timeline.detail: Hairline rectangular fracture detected in the replacement wall.

evidence.title: Salt aggregate 27
evidence.summary: Trace material includes pollen from three incompatible climates.

evidence.title: Interior laser survey
evidence.summary: Interior dimensions exceed exterior wall depth by 1.4 metres.

cases.title: Platform Zero
cases.summary: Station speakers announce arrivals for an unlisted platform after the final scheduled service.
cases.publicFinding: Announcements use a retired voice system and direct named passengers toward a sealed utility stair.

timeline.label: First verified capture
timeline.detail: A maintenance worker recorded an announcement after system shutdown.

timeline.label: Archive mismatch
timeline.detail: One announcement file carries a creation date of 2002.

evidence.title: Platform announcement 06
evidence.summary: Names a passenger who had not yet entered the station.

evidence.title: PA shutdown record
evidence.summary: No playback event or powered endpoint is recorded.

cases.title: The Borrowed Weather
cases.summary: A residential block experiences weather matching forecasts issued for a location no service can resolve.
cases.publicFinding: Temperature, rainfall, and daylight shift within a fixed perimeter. Forecast source alternates between blank and an invalid municipality code.

timeline.label: Report accepted
timeline.detail: Residents documented twelve minutes of frost in tropical conditions.

timeline.label: Name field restored
timeline.detail: Source displayed W— E— for 0.8 seconds before synchronization.

evidence.title: Microclimate sensor array
evidence.summary: Confirms a sharp environmental boundary around seventeen houses.

evidence.title: Source location query
evidence.summary: Result count: one. Displayable results: zero.
